agents.name: relay retries
agents.prompt: Why does the relay drop idle tunnels, and what should we change?

chunks:
## What happens

The relay closes a tunnel after **90 seconds** without traffic. Nothing in the client sends keepalives, so a quiet chat looks *exactly* like a dead one. The timeout lives in `crates/relay/src/tunnel.rs`:

```rust
/// A tunnel with no frames for this long is closed.
const IDLE_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(90);

if last_frame.elapsed() > IDLE_TIMEOUT {
    tunnel.close(Reason::Idle).await;
}
```

### Why it shows up now

1. The phone backgrounds the app and stops reading.
2. The daemon has nothing to send while the agent waits.
   - Asks are the worst case: the agent is blocked on *you*.
   - Long tool calls are next, since no rows stream while they run.
3. The relay sees silence and closes the tunnel.

> The relay is doing what [RELAY.md](docs/RELAY.md) says it should. The gap is that nobody keeps the tunnel warm.

---

### Options

| Option | Cost | Risk |
|---|---|---|
| Client keepalive every 30s | One tiny frame per tunnel | Wakes phones in the background |
| Daemon keepalive every 30s | Same, from the other end | None found |
| Raise the timeout to 10m | Nothing | Dead tunnels linger |

I'd go with the **daemon keepalive**: it needs no client release and keeps the relay's rule intact. See https://github.com/foxred-software/amux/blob/main/crates/relay/src/tunnel.rs#L40-L58 for where it would hook in.

- [x] Reproduced the drop with a 2-minute idle chat
- [ ] Keepalive in the daemon
- [ ] A test that idles past the timeout

Here is how the options compare:

| Option | What changes | Latency | Risk |
|---|---|--:|---|
| Client keepalive | A ping frame every 30s from `ui-runtime`'s pump | 0 ms | Wakes phones in the background, which costs battery on every idle chat |
| Daemon keepalive | The same frame from the host's `relay_client` | 0 ms | None found |
| Raise the timeout | `IDLE_TIMEOUT` goes from 90s to 10m | 0 ms | Dead tunnels linger for up to ten minutes before the relay notices |
| **Do nothing** | — | n/a | The phone keeps dropping chats that wait on an ask |

The daemon keepalive wins: no client release, no battery cost.

The crates it touches:

| Crate | Owner | Lines | Tests | Coverage | Unsafe | Deps | MSRV | Last release | Platforms | Notes |
|---|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|---|---|---|---|
| relay_client | connections team | 4,210 | 118 | 86% lines | none | 14 | 1.85 | 2026-09-28 (v0.7.0) | macOS, Linux, Windows | Owns the tunnel and its reconnect loop |
| relay | connections team | 6,904 | 203 | 79% lines | none | 22 | 1.85 | 2026-09-28 (v0.7.0) | Linux servers only | Closes idle tunnels after IDLE_TIMEOUT |
| ui-runtime | client platform | 9,588 | 341 | 91% lines | none | 18 | 1.85 | 2026-09-30 (v0.7.1) | macOS, Linux, Windows, iOS | Session pump; would carry the client keepalive |
| node | host platform | 12,730 | 402 | 83% lines | two blocks | 31 | 1.85 | 2026-09-30 (v0.7.1) | macOS, Linux, Windows | Hosts the daemon keepalive timer |
| wire | protocol team | 3,120 | 57 | 95% lines | none | 6 | 1.80 | 2026-09-12 (v0.6.4) | everywhere | Gains a Keepalive frame kind |
